note: Crate rustre-debug-linux exists in workspace but is NOT wired into rustre-mcp server (no debug_linux / ProcMaps references in rustre-mcp-server/src). The crate exposes Linux-only ptrace-backed LinuxDebugger ops plus two pure parsers (ProcMapsParser, parse_proc_maps); only the parsers are testable cross-platform and they have no MCP tool surface to compare against. No JSON-RPC calls possible.
